def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    interior = [grid[r][c] for i in range(len(rb)-1) for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for j in range(len(cb)-1) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])]
    bg = max(set(interior), key=interior.count)
    marker = next(x for x in set(interior) if x != bg)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])) >= 2 else bg
             for j in range(len(cb)-1)] for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
